free_tier.stated: A free trial by request: support documentation states 14 days to use 6 hours of credit for a 6-core device, or 18 hours on a 2-core device; Solo trial requests are manually approved and delivered by email invitation. The paid Solo Explorer rate is USD 3 per device-hour.
free_tier.notes: The vendor's trial page gives no numeric credit; the 14-day and 6-hour figures are from the vendor's support FAQ and describe a cloud trial generally, not a Solo-specific public offer. Stored devices count USD 0.25 a day towards the credit.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is a virtual device-hour, not an object

retention.stated: Trial devices are stored between sessions and count towards trial credit; after a subscription expires Corellium removes customer data from the SaaS generally within 30 days.

egress.terms: not published as a device-hour allowance: the pricing and terms pages read state no separate egress price or quota for Solo

record.interface_detail: A Solo Cloud REST API at app.corellium.com/api/docs; virtual devices are reached through ADB, SSH, GDB, serial console and VPN, with Quick Connect over SSH tunnelling.
record.tooling: Corellium REST API with API keys, a Python API client, ADB and SSH clients, and an OpenVPN client for project network access.
record.chaining: An agent or researcher creates a virtual iOS or Android device, connects with ADB or SSH, snapshots and clones device state, and runs security tooling such as Frida; the paid Solo rate is USD 3 per device-hour with no prepaid minimum and one active device.

limits.value: 14 days and 6 hours of credit on a 6-core device (18 hours on a 2-core device) for a cloud trial
Solo allows 1 user and 1 active device; Pay-As-You-Go-style plans elsewhere default to 2 simultaneous devices
trials are manually approved for individuals and businesses, with automated checks and manual review; Solo is for student users only

record.limits_note: A device hour is any hour the device is on, paused, turning on or turning off; usage is measured by the minute and totalled at month end, rounded up. Burst hours above plan hours are charged at the same plan rate. Stored trial devices cost USD 0.25 a day against credit.
record.binding_note: The manually approved, student-only trial gate binds before the 6-hour credit: a request can be denied and a trial invitation is sent by email only on approval.

identity_cost.detail: The app login asks for email and password and directs account creation to a trial request. The trial request form asks whether the applicant is an individual or a company; individual applicants need a valid personal email and company applicants a professional email and company details. Trials are manually approved with automated checks that include an OFAC lookup. The exact form fields are unverified: behind a sign-up, since no request was submitted. Burst hours above plan hours require a credit card.

record.reliability_note: Trials are manually approved and expire after 14 days; if an expired trial is not converted to a subscription, the account is suspended and data is deleted. Device-hours accrue while a device is on or paused, and stored trial devices draw down credit.
record.confidence_note: The USD 3 per device-hour rate, device-hour definition, student-only scope, manual trial approval, email invitation and login fields are quoted from first-party Corellium pages read on 2026-11-25. The 14-day/6-hour credit comes from the vendor's general cloud-trial FAQ, not a Solo-specific price page.

card.summary: A free trial that is documented with real numbers: 'Once registered, you automatically have access to Arm Virtual Hardware and are enrolled on a 30-day free ...

free_tier.stated: A free trial that is documented with real numbers: 'Once registered, you automatically have access to Arm Virtual Hardware and are enrolled on a 30-day free trial. This trial provides access for up to 15 active CPU cores at a time and up to 100 core hours of usage. Your trial includes 25 device slots.' After the trial the rate is 'USD 0.50 per core hour, where a core hour is one hour of CPU core usage on AVH', with 'Discounts... for open-source software development and other non-commercial, academic, or research usage'. The models are instruction-accurate virtual development kits, Corstone fixed virtual platforms and Ethos-U NPU models, and they run in the vendor's cloud rather than on a local machine.

retention.stated: 100 core hours inside 30 days is the cap: a five-core device exhausts the trial in 20 hours of wall clock, and after the 30 days the virtual device shuts down automatically.

egress.terms: not published: the page read states no egress allowance and no overage price; https://support.avh.corellium.com/getting-started/access read 2026-11-03

record.interface_detail: REST API with an API token; AVH CLI installed from npm (@corellium/corellium-cli); SSH to a virtual device over the AVH VPN or an SSH tunnel
record.tooling: the provider documents its own CLI, the AVH CLI, per https://support.avh.corellium.com/sdk/cli/: "The AVH CLI is a command line tool that allows you to manage your AVH instances from the terminal."
record.chaining: It chains with a free CI runner: the same 25 device slots make a firmware or model test suite run in a build, which is the shape the workload needs. It breaks at throughput, because a virtual Ethos-U is a functional model and its latency numbers are not silicon numbers.

card.summary: No free tier: Corellium Solo is priced at USD 3 per device-hour with no pre-paid minimum, for one user and one active device, open to students only; a manual...

free_tier.stated: No free tier: Corellium Solo is priced at USD 3 per device-hour with no pre-paid minimum, for one user and one active device, open to students only; a manually approved trial credits 6 hours over 14 days on a 6-core device, or 18 hours on a 2-core device, and stored devices count USD 0.25 a day against the credit.
free_tier.notes: The trial is reviewed and approved by the vendor and expires; it is not a standing free tier. Enterprise plans Viper and Falcon come with 1,250 device-hours a month and move to burst hours at the same plan rate. Arm Virtual Hardware has its own record and is a different offer.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a virtual mobile device, not an object; each project has a /23 IP space with 512 addresses and effectively 127 devices when devices have two LAN addresses and one service…

retention.stated: A trial expires after 14 days; after expiry, an account not converted to a subscription is suspended and its data is deleted. Stored devices are billed USD 0.25 a day.

egress.terms: Virtual devices have network interfaces connected to the outside world and a per-project private IP range, but the pricing and support pages read state no egress allowance and no price per unit of outbound traffic; unverified: no published egress terms.

record.interface_detail: A browser-based web interface and product portal, a REST API with API keys, the Corellium CLI installed through npm, and SSH into a jailbroken virtual device over a VPN; ADB, GDB and a serial console are also documented.
record.tooling: the web interface; the REST API at https://app.corellium.com/api/docs for Solo Cloud customers with API keys; the Corellium CLI installed with 'npm install -g @corellium/corellium-cli'; SSH, ADB, GDB and a serial console; REST and JavaScript and Python API clients
record.chaining: Virtual devices in a project can be driven from a CI workflow with the CLI and REST API, and snapshots and cloning preserve device state; a workflow that needs files to outlive a deleted account needs a separate object-storage record.

limits.value: 6 hours of trial credit in 14 days for a 6-core device, or 18 hours on a 2-core device; stored devices count USD 0.25 a day against the credit
Solo at USD 3 per device-hour, one user and one active device; enterprise plans include 1,250 device-hours a month before burst hours at the same rate
each project has a /23 IP space of 512 addresses, with an effective limit of 127 devices for products with two LAN addresses and one service address

record.limits_note: Device-hour usage is measured per minute and totaled at month end, then rounded up to the next whole hour. A device is active when it is on, paused, turning on or turning off; a device that is off is not billed. Unused plan hours do not roll over. Trial access requires manual approval.
record.binding_note: The 6 trial hours in 14 days run out before the per-project device count or the paid device-hour meter, and the trial is the only no-cost capacity.

identity_cost.detail: A trial request is required and reviewed: 'Once we receive your trial request, we'll contact you if we need more information. If approved, you will receive a trial invitation by email.' Cloud trials are manually approved for individuals and businesses with automated checks such as an OFAC lookup and a manual review. Solo is for student users only. No card, phone number, ID document or institution field is published on the trial request page.

record.reliability_note: Trials are manually approved and can be denied; the vendor states an account left unconverted after the trial is suspended and its data is deleted. Device-hour billing rounds the monthly total up to the next whole hour. Stored devices are billed USD 0.25 a day.
record.confidence_note: The per-device-hour rate, the one-user one-device cap, the trial credit and its 14-day horizon, the approval gate, the interface routes and the per-project address space are quoted from Corellium's own pricing, product, trial and support pages read on 2026-11-24.
